calls.summary: Caller with no stay asked about availability for two nights. Details taken; a manager will call back.

turns.message: Hi, this is Eryn at Fernbrook Inn. How can I help with your stay?
Hi, I'm not staying — I wanted to ask about rooms for next weekend.
I can check what we have available — when were you thinking of coming?
Friday, for two nights.
Let me look... we have a Suite at two hundred and forty a night, and a Standard at one hundred and sixty. Which sounds better?
The suite, please.
Lovely. Can I take your first name and an email for the confirmation?
Rowan, and it's rowan.k@example.com.
That's rowan.k@example.com — have I got that right?
Yes.
Then I've put that request in for you. I'm not confirming the room myself — a manager will call you back shortly to confirm and take payment, and the confirmation comes by email.

calls.summary: Caller not recognised by number; identified by room and booking name, then asked for a highchair.

turns.message: Hi, this is Eryn at Fernbrook Inn. How can I help with your stay?
Hi, I need something for our room.
Happy to help. I don't have your number on file — are you staying with us at the moment, or looking to book?
We're staying, it's under my husband's name.
No trouble at all. What room are you in, and what name is the room under?
The Otto room, under Ellis.
Thanks — I've got the Otto room, under Ellis. How can I help?
Could someone bring up a highchair?
Of course. I've passed that to the team for the Otto room — someone will be up with it shortly.
Perfect, thank you.

calls.summary: Guest asked for extra towels and a 7am wake-up call. Both were arranged.

turns.message: Hi, this is Eryn at Fernbrook Inn. How can I help with your stay?
Hi — could I get some extra towels sent up?
Of course. I have you as Jordan in the Otto room — is that right?
That's right.
Lovely. I've asked housekeeping for extra towels for the Otto room — they'll be up shortly. Anything else?
Actually yes, can you wake me at seven tomorrow?
Seven in the morning, done — I've set that for you. Anything else I can do?
No that's it, thanks.
Wonderful. Sleep well, Jordan.
